prod.name: orders_issue_timing_v2_check
prod.definition: CHECK (NOT workflow_flag_enabled('workflow_issue_v2_enforce'::text) OR (issue_state <> 'cancelled'::text OR first_delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT legacy_delivery_confirmed) AND ((issue_state <> ALL (ARRAY['returned'::text, 'doctor_rejected'::text, 'redo'::text])) OR first_delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR legacy_delivery_confirmed) AND (issue_state <> 'lab_rejected'::text OR first_delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT legacy_delivery_confirmed AND design_submitted_at IS NULL))

local.name: orders_issue_timing_v2_check

constraintsOnlyProd.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_shape_check
constraintsOnlyProd.definition:
CHECK (lifecycle_configuration IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration) = 'object'::text AND lifecycle_configuration ? 'rules'::text AND
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) = 'array'::text THEN jsonb_array_length(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) >= 1 AND jsonb_array_length(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) <= 1000
    ELSE false
END)

constraintsOnlyProd.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_standard_only_check
constraintsOnlyProd.definition: CHECK (type = 'STANDARD'::storage.buckettype OR lifecycle_configuration IS NULL AND lifecycle_configuration_generation IS NULL)

limitations: No live auth/assignment mutation tests or user sessions were exercised.
Catalogs were sampled in separate read-only transactions, not one cross-environment atomic snapshot.
No ledger repair, migrations, backfill, bucket change, feature toggle or deployment was run.
Storage platform-owned catalog drift is not an instruction to copy platform objects.
